bull_bear.body: Disciplined approach; all capex funded through internal accruals; no debt raise indicated for immediate plans; focus on reinvestment for capacity and efficiency.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Global geopolitical volatility affecting logistics/raw materials; Raw material price volatility (crude/gas); Execution risk on massive greenfield project; Regulatory delays for new land approvals.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and conservative; emphasizes operational efficiency over price spikes; cautious on quarter-to-quarter guidance but firm on annual FY27 targets; transparent on capacity utilization metrics.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Management explicitly denied inventory gains driving margins, attributing success to efficiency and mix; Ibuprofen demand recovery is structural post-destocking (expected to last 4-6 quarters); Greenfield project is in early regulatory stages with 6-8 quarter timeline to commissioning.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet carries nil non-current borrowings in each of Mar-22 through Mar-26; current borrowings stand at Rs 132.0 Cr at Mar-26 against total equity of Rs 1798.4 Cr.
- Capital deployment is reinvestment-led - investing cash outflow of Rs 198.1 Cr in FY26 against net operating cash inflow of Rs 214.4 Cr, with Rs 200-250 Crs of capex guided for FY26-27.
- The deck contains no dividend, buyback or payout policy statement.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Pharma: Ibuprofen contributes ~62% of pharma revenue, running at 90-95% utilization; Non-Ibu (Paracetamol, Metformin, Clopidogrel) ~38%, with new Paracetamol capacity at 55% utilization (targeting 75% in FY27); Chemicals: Ethyl Acetate and Acetic Anhydride running at 98-100% utilization post-expansion.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Competitor exiting Ibuprofen due to unremunerative prices | Granules India | beneficiary | Med | While IOLCP sees Ibuprofen as profitable at 90%+ utilization, a peer's exit could consolidate market share for efficient players like Granules or IOLCP itself, though IOLCP declined to comment on acquiring assets. |
| Rising Paracetamol demand and capacity constraints in India | Granules India | beneficiary | Low | IOLCP ramping new Paracetamol capacity; if demand outstrips supply, peers with established scale like Granules may see pricing power, though IOLCP is adding significant capacity. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Described as a diversified API company with global Ibuprofen leadership on a backward-integrated manufacturing platform, serving a customer base across 80 countries with 3000+ employees.
- "Among the largest global manufacturers of Iso Butyl Benzene (IBB) worldwide" and a "Major producer of Ethyl Acetate in India with a capacity of 1,20,000 MTPA, and Acetic Anhydride with a capacity of 32,000 MTPA".
- Regulatory moat cited as 21 CEPs with EDQM and 14 DMFs with USFDA, plus USFDA-approved facility, EU-GMP, ANVISA Brazil GMP approval (May 2024) across all 10 API manufacturing units, CDE of NMPA China, MFDS Korea and Russian Federation GMP.
- Deck claims 'Asia's first continuous dual technology plant for MCA and Acetyl Chloride using green chemistry', and REACH certification for Ethyl Acetate and Acetic Anhydride enabling EU exports.
- Way-forward slide argues that with 14 USFDA DMFs, 21 EDQM CEPs, USFDA-audited API facilities and multiple EU-GMP approved units, the company is "well-placed for regulated market expansion".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary] Incorporated IOL Pharmaxis UK Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, in 2025; the deck gives no financials or mandate for it and all statements presented are standalone.
- [Guidance] FY26-27 guidance: revenue growth 15%-20%, EBITDA margin 14%-15%, exports contribution 25%-30%, capex Rs 200-250 Crs.
- [Governance] Board of 8 with 4 independent directors (50% independent), an independent director as Chairman, average board tenure of 10 years and 96% average attendance; promoter family holds MD, Joint MD and Executive Director roles.
- [Industry] Deck cites China+1 sourcing shift, patent expirations through 2030, PLI/KSM self-reliance incentives and India's position as the 3rd largest API producer supplying 8% of the global API industry and 20% of the world's generic medicines (source: Imarc, pib.gov.in).
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Q4 EBITDA margin 15.2% driven by operating leverage and product mix; raw material price increases being passed through to customers; spreads stable to slightly improved; FY27 margin guidance 14-14.5%.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: FY27 Revenue Growth: 15-18% (mid-to-high teens); EBITDA Margin: 14-14.5%; Order Inflow: Stable demand for 4-6 quarters; Capex: INR 200-250cr annually for next 4-5 years (Total INR 1,200-1,400cr greenfield).
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: No formal order book disclosed; demand visibility strong for 4-6 quarters with Ibuprofen destocking complete and Chemicals running at 98-100% utilization.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Greenfield project (100 acres, Bhatinda) with INR 1,200-1,400cr capex over 4-5 years; Paracetamol capacity ramp-up from 55% to 75% in FY27 and full utilization by FY28; Increasing non-Ibu exports to regulated markets (target 25% of non-Ibu sales in FY27).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: IOLCP delivered record Q4 revenue (INR 619cr, +17.4% YoY) and margin expansion (EBITDA 15.2%, +251bps) driven by near-maximum utilization in chemicals and recovering Ibuprofen demand, while guiding for sustained mid-to-high teen growth in FY27 supported by new Paracetamol capacity ramp-up and a massive INR 1,200-1,400cr greenfield project over 4-5 years.

open.item: Punjab-floods fuel-cost impact (~Rs 7-8 crore, ~1% margin) expected to normalize in Q3, reducing power cost by Rs 5-6 crore.
Management expects chemical-segment EBITDA margin of 5% to 6% for FY26.
Newly acquired 101-acre site to take 6-8 quarters for regulatory approvals; commercialization not expected until after FY26.

Management is hopeful of securing most of the remaining regulatory approvals for the greenfield site within the next three to four months, after which work will start there (environmental clearance already in place).
Company applied for environmental approvals for the new Chandigarh-Bathinda land and hopes to ramp up the facility in 18 to 24 months.
Management targets 40-45% export share for the company as a whole over the next two years, focused on European market.
Management guides for mid-teen to high-teen (around 15%, +/- 1-2%) revenue growth in FY27 versus FY26.
Management guides for FY27 blended EBITDA margin of around 14% to 14.5%, up from 12.4% in FY26.
Company targets increasing its non-ibuprofen export/regulated-market share to around 25% in FY2027 (from ~20% currently).
Paracetamol utilization on the enhanced 10,800 MT capacity (currently 55%) is expected to rise to around 70-75% in FY27 and reach full utilization by FY28.
Management is targeting around INR2,700 crore revenue in FY27 with roughly 15% annual top-line growth.
Management targets FY27 revenue of Rs 2,600-2,700 crore with EBITDA margin of 13-15%, expecting 10-15% revenue growth and 1-2% margin improvement each year.
Management aims to scale total export revenue from ~27% to about 40% (stated elsewhere 40-45%) over the medium term / next 2 years.
Management targets increasing export to 40% of total revenue (company-wide, chemical+pharma) in the coming two years (currently ~25%).
Management targets Rs 2,000 crore combined from Ibuprofen and non-Ibuprofen segments in the next two years.
Non-ibuprofen segment revenue targeted to roughly double from ~Rs 500 crore to Rs 800-1,000 crore in two-three years.
Management targets ~50% export realization from the non-ibuprofen segment within the next 2-3 years (currently ~23-24%).
Non-commodity APIs Clopidogrel, Pantoprazole and Fenofibrate each have potential of around INR100 crore to INR150 crore in the upcoming two years.
Management aims to raise total export share from ~30% to 45-50%, especially into regulated markets, over 3-4 years.
Management targets Rs 3,000 crore topline by FY28 from existing products, growing ~12-13% every year.

verdicts.item: Management expects company-wide EBITDA margin of around 13% to 15% over the next 2-3 years.
verdicts.note: Q4FY26 EBITDA margin 15.2% reached the top of the 13-15% band; full-year 12.4%, FY27 guided 14-14.5%. Approaching/into the band; 2-3 yr horizon open. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Management is confident of achieving ~10% (10-15%) revenue growth on a blended basis in FY26.
verdicts.note: FY26 revenue growth 11.5% — met/beat the ~10% (10-15%) FY26 growth commitment.

verdicts.item: Management estimates topline growth of around 10% to 12% considering the current scenario (asked re FY26/FY27).
verdicts.note: 'revenue from operations stood at INR2,319 crores, representing a growth of 11.5 percentage year-on-year' — within the 10-12% FY26 guide.

verdicts.item: Ibuprofen capacity utilization (currently ~75%) expected to rise to around 90% in the next two to three quarters.
verdicts.note: 'ibu, metformin, clopidogrel and fenofibrate... running almost at 85% to 95% capacity utilization... around 90% average' — Ibuprofen at/above the ~90% target.

verdicts.item: Chemical segment margin/performance expected to improve slightly from current quarter, aided by new Europe exports and Acetic Anhydride.
verdicts.note: 'Our chemical business also delivered a strong performance during the quarter with improvement in both realisation and profitability'; ethyl-acetate spreads improved. Chemical margin improved as expec…

verdicts.item: Management expects 10% to 15% revenue growth in FY26 from all products, a mix of volume and price.
verdicts.note: FY26 revenue growth 11.5% — within the promised 10-15% FY26 range. FY26 complete.

verdicts.item: Company plans capex of Rs 150-200 crore in FY26 (growth, infra, automation) as in prior years.
verdicts.note: 'the company incurred capex of around INR160 crores... funded entirely through internal accruals' — within the Rs 150-200 cr FY26 plan. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: 101-acre Chandigarh-Bathinda greenfield: industrial, environmental and NHI clearances underway and progressing into FY26; same chemicals+API model with some forward integration.
verdicts.note: 'Environmental clearances is also done', few approvals secured, few awaited; 'more or less similar of the existing IOL's Plant. Mix of chemical and the API.' Clearances progressed through FY26 as stat…

verdicts.item: Company is setting up Unit 9B (carved out of Unit 9) to manufacture Minoxidil and intermediates, expected to be completed by Q3 FY26.
verdicts.note: 'The company further strengthened its non-Ibuprofen segment through the launch of Minoxidil' — Unit 9B / Minoxidil project delivered (launched during FY26).

verdicts.item: Paracetamol plant utilization (34% in Q1) expected to reach ~60% by Q3 FY26, and optimum next year.
verdicts.note: 'we have achieved around 55% capacity utilization on enhanced level' at FY26-end — below the 60%-by-Q3FY26 target; 'optimum' now pushed to FY28 (75% in FY27). [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Management expects to touch or come very close to a Rs 600 crore quarterly revenue mark within the remaining quarters of FY26.
verdicts.note: 'revenue from operations of INR619 crores... a year-on-year growth of around 17.4%', the 'highest-ever quarterly revenue' — crossed the Rs 600 cr quarterly mark within FY26. [±10% rule]

wtt.summary: 50% guidance hit (23 chains); 4/4 projects on-time; 3 expired; 22% theme consistency (info)
wtt.tone_latest: Confident and upbeat after a record-revenue quarter; management stressed judging performance annually rather than quarter-to-quarter given global dynamism, and reaffirmed prior FY27 guidance without owning any material miss.
